sqlite3 -readonly -header -column \""'$DB" "SELECT ic.name AS course_name, ic.level, cn.id AS node_id, cn.slug, cn.name, ccn.relation, ccn.confidence, ccn.mapping_status FROM institute_courses ic JOIN course_career_nodes ccn ON ccn.course_id=ic.id JOIN career_nodes cn ON cn.id=ccn.node_id WHERE lower(ic.name) LIKE '"'%chem%' OR lower(ic.name) LIKE '%econom%' OR lower(ic.name) LIKE '%polit%' OR lower(ic.name) LIKE '%sociol%' LIMIT 100;\""

item.command:
/bin/bash -c "DB='assets/data/career_path.db'
sqlite3 -readonly -header -separator "'$'"'\\t' \""'$DB" <<'"'SQL'
WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(id, slug, name, parent_id, depth, target_id) AS (
  SELECT id, slug, name, parent_id, 0, id FROM career_nodes WHERE id IN (155,25,21,68,71,67,72,73)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.id, p.slug, p.name, p.parent_id, a.depth + 1, a.target_id
  FROM career_nodes p JOIN ancestors a ON a.parent_id = p.id
)
SELECT target_id, group_concat(name, ' > ') AS reversed_names
FROM ancestors GROUP BY target_id ORDER BY target_id;
